title: Grand Kru County health-worker sit-in over delayed salaries
reason: The opened Local Voices article dates the gathering as Monday; December 21, 2020 is derived from its December 22 publication date. The action began before February 2021 and no source establishes that it continued into this unit month.
notes: The article reports 17 Community Health Supervisors and 129 Community Health Assistants and says they intended to stay for many days. Workforce totals are not a February crowd count, planned duration is not verified duration, and no February continuation was found.

title: Nationwide warning strikes announced by the Public Workers Consortium
reason: The search-result excerpt describes intended future warning strikes but provides no evidence that a strike was executed in February 2021.
notes: The reported press conference remains a separate pending discovery lead as E002. An announcement is not an executed gathering or strike.
